question:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only J sits to the

 left of Q. Only four people sit between J and I. Only O sits between P and K and P is not

 an immediate neighbour of I. Who sits at the extreme right end of the row?
